design_philosophy.core_concept: The Command Center for your Life
principles: Deep Focus: Use absolute blacks (#09090b) to minimize eye strain and maximize concentration.
Neon Accents: Use high-contrast neon colors sparingly to guide attention to data.
Glassmorphism: Use subtle glass overlays for cards to create depth without clutter.
Density with Breathing Room: High data density (Bento grids) balanced with generous internal padding.

instructions_to_main_agent: THEME SETUP: Ensure 'dark' class is applied to the html/body by default.
NAVIGATION: Create a unified sidebar or bottom nav (mobile) that allows seamless switching between 'Nutrition', 'Agenda', and 'Finance' without full page reloads if possible (use React Router).
AI CHAT: The AI Chat should be a floating action button (FAB) or a persistent sidebar widget that can overlay context.
CHARTS: Use 'Recharts' with the custom color palettes defined in 'colors.modules'.
GLASSMORPHISM: Apply 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/50 border-white/10' to all major dashboard containers.
ICONS: Use 'Lucide-React' icons. Stroke width should be 1.5px or 2px for clarity.
PORTUGUESE: All static text must be in Portuguese (BR). Use 'Bom dia', 'Agenda', 'Nutrição', 'Finanças', 'Configurações'.
TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors: separates good from extraordinary.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
